current_state.zh: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter (42B active) open-weights model published on Hugging Face with broad inference-runner and Mac Studio support, prompting community debate over its competitive benchmarks versus Qwen and GLM models and its revenue-capped 'Model as a Service' license clause.
